description:
Role Name: Coldfusion Programmer 
 Location: Salem, OR 
 Duration: 10+ Months 
 
 
 Description - Reviews, analyzes, and modifies programming systems including encoding, testing, debugging and documenting programs. May require a bachelor's degree. Requires 5 years or more of experience in the field or in a related area. Familiar with a variety of the field's concepts, practices, and procedures. Relies on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals. Performs a variety of complicated tasks. May lead and direct the work of Contractor staff. A wide degree of creativity and latitude is expected. 
 
 The purpose of this request is to procure Software Developer Services for maintenance to the Electronic Bidding Information Distribution System (eBIDS). This position is located within the ODOT Information Systems Branch, Transportation Applications Development Section, but primarily serving the Technical Services Branch. The contractor will update the system based on changes brought about by the Trnsport Web Migration Project. The Trnsport database is going from DB2 to MS SQL and there will be major table and database changes. Developer work will include analysis of data changes and updating system data scripting. 

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
